finding.title: Percent-encoded credential markers cross every free-form boundary
finding.description: The independently generated percent-encoded assignment and JSON-key forms were accepted by normalizeMetadata, normalizeReason, normalizeConnectionDefinition metadata, normalizeConnectionEvent metadata, and the public schema; createConnectionStore appended one authoritative event for each form. A downstream form/query decoder would recover the credential marker, but the detector checks the literal candidate without URL/form decoding.

controlsPassed: all seven client-secret, client_secret, client secret, prefixed, and case-variant assignments
all eight Unicode format controls in URL-shaped values
all eight Unicode format controls in URL-safe/base64-shaped values
lowercase, uppercase, escaped lowercase, escaped uppercase, and client-secret JSON keys
metadata nesting, array depth, 32/33 item, 64/65 property, and Unicode code-point boundaries
detector sensitivity after removing the assignment branch
cold lifecycle/replay parity, authorization, capture binding, and canary scan
replay: Replay: N/A (server connection model) + mitigation: cold-clone reducer replay, secret-shaped input corpus, authz matrix, exact lifecycle digests, and independent runtime/store/public boundary probes
